mapper.select: SELECT r.contract_id AS contractId, c.filename AS filename, r.risk_level AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS riskCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_item ri WHERE ri.contract_id = r.contract_id ) AS totalCount FROM risk_item r LEFT JOIN contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id GROUP BY r.contract_id, r.risk_level, c.filename ORDER BY riskCount DESC, r.contract_id ASC
